reason: Clarify that partial prepayment should be allowed.

proposed_change.old_text: The right to prepay the loan at any time, in whole or in part, with no penalty, subject only to a short 30-day notice period.
proposed_change.new_text: The company may prepay the loan at any time, in whole or in part, without penalty, subject only to 30 days notice and accrued interest through the prepayment date.
